correctness.rationale: Exact lower-triangular Hardy coefficient identity and rational Gram trace formulas were reconstructed. Step-kernel Hilbert–Schmidt O(h) comparison yields an l2 singular-value bound through Mirsky. The limiting positive kernel gives a fourth-order ODE with correctly derived infinity asymptotics and left boundary conditions. Its two entire independent solutions yield the stated determinant and the converse positive spectral characterization. The 670 standard-library exact-rational assertions check algebra and first-root bracket, not infinite-dimensional proofs.
